author: RichardLynes
text:
Subject: OpenAI has placed me in a position where I cannot recover, export, or practically preserve approximately 18 months of my own ChatGPT history

I am documenting what has happened to my ChatGPT account because after months of support correspondence, I have reached a point where OpenAI's own policies have effectively trapped my historical data inside a Business workspace that I do not want to continue paying for.

OpenAI Support has now confirmed several critical facts in writing.

First, Support states:

“A Personal-to-Business merge is permanent and cannot be undone.”

They further state:

“Data export isn't available in a ChatGPT Business workspace.”

And:

“the previous Personal workspace can't be recovered.”

This means that once my Personal workspace was merged into the Business workspace, I lost the ability to return to the Personal workspace where that history originally existed, while simultaneously losing the normal ability to export that history from the Business workspace.

OpenAI Support also states that if I cancel the Business subscription:

“users won't be able to access the workspace.”

They add that the data supposedly remains intact, but access is unavailable unless the Business workspace is later reactivated.

Taken together, these statements create an extraordinary situation:

I cannot undo the migration.

I cannot recover my former Personal workspace.

I cannot export the migrated data from the Business workspace.

And if I stop paying for a Business workspace I no longer want, I lose access to the workspace containing that history.

That is not meaningful data portability. It is a form of practical lock-in.

I have approximately 18 months of conversations, research, project history, uploaded materials, and intellectual work associated with ChatGPT. I am not asking OpenAI to recreate lost information or provide something extraordinary. I am asking for the ability to obtain a backup of my own data before discontinuing a service I no longer wish to use.

What makes this especially troubling is that OpenAI is telling me, in substance, that the migration is permanent, the original Personal workspace cannot be restored, and the Business workspace cannot be exported.

I should not have to maintain a paid Business subscription indefinitely simply to preserve access to historical data that originated in my Personal account.

I also should not have to choose between continuing to pay for an unwanted workspace and losing practical access to approximately 18 months of my own work.

I find this unacceptable and deeply disappointing from a company that presents itself as building tools people should be able to trust.

My request is straightforward:

Provide me with a complete downloadable copy of the data that was migrated into the Business workspace — including conversations, Projects, uploaded files and attachments — before the workspace is deactivated or deleted.

I am not asking for special treatment. I am asking for a reasonable way to preserve my own data.

If OpenAI cannot provide that, then I believe customers deserve to know that merging a Personal workspace into Business may result in a permanent migration from which the user cannot return, while also leaving them without a normal export mechanism.

I have repeatedly attempted to resolve this privately through Support. I am making the issue public because those efforts have not produced a workable solution.

Richard D. Lynes

OpenAI Support Case 12018350
